data.name: Prevention.Upcoming.Hint
data.value: A friendly reminder, {0} day(s) before the due date, to customers whose payment weather is rainy or stormy, with the link to their customer area and the bank transfer QR code. It goes out on the customer's best day when the weather gives one, and follows automatic sending.

data.name: Prevention.Upcoming.Off
data.value: The reminder before the due date is off: turn it on in the reminder schedule below.

data.name: Prevention.Upcoming.Empty
data.value: No reminder before the due date to plan

data.name: Prevention.Upcoming.Empty.Text
data.value: No invoice of a customer with rainy or stormy weather falls due within two weeks.

data.name: Prevention.Objection.Hint
data.value: The customer objects to targeting based on how they pay: they will no longer get a reminder before the due date, and their quotes leave the weighted order book.

data.name: Prevention.Objection.Text
data.value: Choosing who gets the reminder before the due date from the way they pay is profiling: every customer can object. They still get the reminders after the due date, which target no one. The objection also applies to the weighted order book: their quotes no longer get a probability and their past quotes count in no rate.

data.name: Prevention.Objection.None
data.value: No customer has objected to targeting.

data.name: Prevention.Plans.Hint
data.value: Requested by your business customers in their customer area, within the schedule's bounds: granted right away, the same for everyone. While a payment plan runs, the invoice gets one reminder per missed instalment only.

data.name: Prevention.Plans.Off
data.value: Self-service payment plans are off: turn them on in the reminder schedule to offer them in the customer area.

data.name: Prevention.Plans.Empty.Text
data.value: Payment plans requested in the customer area will show here.

data.name: Prevention.Plans.Cancel.Hint
data.value: End the payment plan: the invoice goes back to its usual reminders.

data.name: Prevention.Plan.RequestedBy
data.value: Requested by {0} on {1}, in the customer area.

data.name: Prevention.Plan.Effect
data.value: While the payment plan runs, the usual reminders stop: one reminder per missed instalment only. If it is not kept, the invoice goes back to its schedule.

data.name: Prevention.Toast.Cancelled
data.value: Payment plan of invoice {0} stopped: the invoice goes back to its reminders.

data.name: Prevention.Toast.Objected
data.value: {0} will no longer get a reminder before the due date.

data.name: Prevention.Settings.BeforeDue
data.value: Send a reminder before the due date to customers with rainy or stormy weather

data.name: Prevention.Settings.BeforeDue.Hint
data.value: The reminder follows automatic sending: without it, it waits to be sent from the list of reminders before the due date.

data.name: Prevention.Settings.Plans
data.value: Offer self-service payment plans in the customer area (business customers)

data.name: Prevention.Settings.Plans.Hint
data.value: The same bounds for every customer, never based on a score: 2 to 3 instalments, one week to one month apart, the last one before the legal payment ceiling (60 days after issue or 45 days end of month, whichever is later). A disputed invoice is not spread.
